strings.briefing:
Orders and customers from two systems. Make one table that tells the full story of every order.

Nothing is documented. In Python, df holds the orders and customers holds the people; put your combined table in df (df = ...), and that is what gets judged.

In SQL, data holds the orders and customers the people.

Create a NEW table named result that holds your answer: CREATE TABLE result AS SELECT ...; That table is what gets judged. You can run your query as often as you like; each run replaces the old result.
